title: Physical implications of a $0$-dimensional base
html:
At dimension 0, all spatial extent vanishes and the physical content becomes purely algebraic.

  1. Primordial state. The vortex filaments, flows, and spatial modes of higher-dimensional strata are absent. The fibre \mathcal{S}_p alone encodes the initial fermionic datum.
  2. Mass. Lacking a base manifold for integration, the nonabelian multiplicative integral of the mass identity degenerates. The surface \Sigma collapses to a point, and the holonomy around \gamma reduces to a single fibre evaluation m = \lVert L \wedge F^+\rVert(p). Dimension-0 mass is an instantaneous, pointwise quantity rather than a distributed one.
  3. Lepton generations. All vertical harmonic forms (Betti numbers on branes) concentrate at the point. The Euler characteristic \chi(\mathcal{S}_p) retains the count of fermionic degrees of freedom without spatial multiplicity.
